{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ukian satellite network''' was a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] system of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the satellite network was used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to detect the approach of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces.
